summary: GLM-5.3 (744B) on six RTX PRO 6000 GPUs: PRESET=glm53-csf-tp6 with TP6 and DCP 1, 2, 3 or 6; DCP6 holds the full 1M-token context
compatibility: New preset and option; other models are unchanged. glm53-csf-tp8 no longer sets B12X_W4A16_SMALL_M_SPLITK.
details: PRESET=glm53-csf-tp6 serves local-inference-lab/GLM-5.3-NVFP4-CSF (a4d40693) with TP6 (attention heads padded to 66, expert channels to 2112), MTP3, 16 request slots and a 4,096-token prefill budget at 94% of GPU memory; the DCP groups' NCCL exchanges use two channels.

6x RTX PRO 6000 (MTP-normalized decode steps/s at C1 / C2 / C4): DCP1 227,520 KV tokens, 66.2 / 100.2 / 161.0; DCP2 452,223, 54.8 / 83.7 / 134.7; DCP3 678,336, 51.0 / 75.1 / 119.3; DCP6 1,362,649 (the full 1M context), 43.7 / 63.1 / 108.6, about 2,200 prefill tokens/s.
New option dcp-comm-backend (DCP_COMM_BACKEND); GLM-5.3 at DCP6 derives ag_rs, which prefills seven times faster there than vLLM's generic all-to-all.
glm53-csf-tp8 drops the small-M split-K opt-in: with b12x #487 the FP4-CSF checkpoint decodes within 2% of the original at TP8 and keeps 535,808 KV tokens against 489,920.
